## 10 - EGX Reversal Scanner

Independent 0-100 reversal score (code/reversalScore.js): oversold RSI, support proximity, volume spike, bullish candle structure, MACD improvement. Kept structurally separate from the momentum scanner since the two setups actively disagree on what 'good RSI' looks like.

positiveDivergence is conservatively left false in v1 — robust divergence detection needs more history-aware peak/trough matching than is worth the risk of false positives here; see docs/SCORING.md.

Requires 04, 05, 06 to have already run for the same asOfDate.

INSERT INTO scanner_runs (trading_date, run_type, status, started_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'RUNNING', now())
ON CONFLICT (trading_date, run_type) DO UPDATE SET trading_date = EXCLUDED.trading_date
RETURNING id, trading_date;
SELECT id, symbol FROM stocks WHERE exchange = $1 AND active = TRUE ORDER BY symbol;

WITH recent_prices AS (
  SELECT trading_date, open, high, low, close, volume
  FROM daily_prices WHERE stock_id = $1 AND trading_date <= $2
  ORDER BY trading_date DESC LIMIT 25
),
recent_ta AS (
  SELECT trading_date, ema9, ema20, ema50, ema200, rsi14, macd, macd_signal, macd_histogram,
         atr14, relative_volume20, high20, high252, low252, distance_52w_high
  FROM technical_analysis WHERE stock_id = $1 AND trading_date <= $2
  ORDER BY trading_date DESC LIMIT 25
),
sr AS (
  SELECT support1, support2, support3, resistance1, resistance2, resistance3,
         support1_strength, nearest_support_distance_pct, nearest_resistance_distance_pct
  FROM support_resistance WHERE stock_id = $1 AND trading_date = $2
)
SELECT
  (SELECT json_agg(p.* ORDER BY p.trading_date DESC) FROM recent_prices p) AS prices,
  (SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.trading_date DESC) FROM recent_ta t) AS ta,
  (SELECT row_to_json(sr) FROM sr) AS sr;

INSERT INTO scanner_results (scanner_run_id, stock_id, reversal_score, reasons_json, warnings_json)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (scanner_run_id, stock_id) DO UPDATE SET
  reversal_score = EXCLUDED.reversal_score,
  reasons_json = COALESCE(scanner_results.reasons_json, '[]'::jsonb) || EXCLUDED.reasons_json,
  warnings_json = COALESCE(scanner_results.warnings_json, '[]'::jsonb) || EXCLUDED.warnings_json;
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS scored_count FROM scanner_results WHERE scanner_run_id = $1 AND reversal_score > 0;
